notes.title: V 1.0.3
notes.content: - After playing for multiple levels, the Steam build began lagging exponentially, to fix this I've lowered the scalability settings and corrected a few more optimisation metrics to do with lighting

notes.title: Powerfall V1.0.2
notes.content: - Fixed a bug on level 9 where the initial spawn point was offset, meaning the player would spawn over the death zone, changed it to be set on the platform
